description: This file defines the Engine class, which models the <engine> element in a configuration XML for the OFBiz framework. It parses engine attributes and parameters from an XML Element, providing access to engine metadata and its parameters.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Represents an engine element with its attributes and parameters, providing methods to access parameter data.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an Engine instance by parsing an XML Element. Extracts 'name', 'class', and 'parameter' elements, throwing ServiceConfigException if attributes are missing or empty.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the engine.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the engine.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a Parameter object by its name.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of all parameters.

methods.name: getParameterValue
methods.description: Returns the value of a parameter by name, or null if not found.
